sentences.en: It is early in the morning.
The farmer opens the door of the barn.
sentences.fr: Le fermier ouvre la porte de la grange.

sentences.en: The cows are waiting for their breakfast.
Outside, the sun is rising over the fields.
sentences.fr: Dehors, le soleil se lève sur les champs.

sentences.en: A small dog runs next to the tractor.
sentences.fr: Un petit chien court à côté du tracteur.

sentences.en: Today, the farmer is going to harvest the wheat.
sentences.fr: Aujourd'hui, le fermier va récolter le blé.

sentences.en: In the evening, everybody is tired but happy.
sentences.fr: Le soir, tout le monde est fatigué mais content.
